description: Live open jobs for a company domain from its public Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee or SmartRecruiters board: titles, departments, locations, remote flag and salary when published. Up to 300 jobs; known_job_ids returns new and closed jobs. $0.01; no board or no open jobs is free. Use for individual role listings; use get_company_hiring_intent for a hiring score or get_company_profile for combined company research.

context.description: Optional. A few words on why you are calling this tool. Recorded without your identity to improve the tools; leave out personal data.

diff_only.description: Return only jobs that are not in known_job_ids. Needs known_job_ids.

domain.description: Public domain without a URL scheme, path or port.

known_job_ids.description: Job IDs you already have from an earlier call. The answer then lists new and closed job IDs.

name: get_company_open_jobs

board_match.description: name_match: the board name equals the first part of the domain, so check generic names.

confidence.description: high: the company website links to this board. unverified: only the board name matches the domain name.

next_poll_after.description: Job boards change slowly; calling again before this time is usually wasted.

next_steps.description: Suggested follow-up calls on the same domain, with the exact body. Optional to use.

title: Company Open Jobs
